title: This app has potential, but issues persist
text:
Of all the bill tracking and finance apps available on the Apple Store, this one had the most potential to be both useful and straightforward to use. I signed up for a one year subscription, but reluctantly deleted the app and decided to wait a few months to see if bug fixes resolve my problem. 

My problem appears to be related to an issue between my credit union and Plaid ( a middleman banking security system). In the app, I tried multiple times to link my credit accounts with the app. I was able to make some progress by logging in as a “guest” which then took me to my credit union sign-in page (rather than the Plaid sign in system). I was then given the option to link my 8 accounts with the app. As luck would have it, two of the accounts (a checking and savings account)  *both end in the same four digits* even though the accounts have different names. There is no way to edit the account information to enter the full account numbers for clarification. I frequently move money back and forth between these two accounts. Unfortunately the checking account was showing double entries for items while the savings account was accurate. I tried unlinking and reconnecting the app multiple times, only to have the error persist or for the checking account to not appear in the app once I reconnected to the credit union (even though it said I had linked all 8 accounts). Another step that helped at one point was to rename the email address in the app profile from a randomly assigned apple email address to the actual email address my credit union has on file. 

In the end, deleting and reinstalling the app did not solve the problem between the problematic checking and savings account. Rather than getting involved in a three-way finger pointing exercise between the app developer, Plaid and the credit union, I’ll try reinstalling the app in a few months and see if the bug has been addressed. So close, yet so far away…
